description: Divergent Merch Design Challenge 2026: Design Beyond the Ordinary. Create What Represents You. What if merchandise could be more than just a logo printed on a T-shirt? What if it could represent a community, a mindset, a creative journey, and a way of thinking? Divergent Classes invites creative minds, design aspirants, and college students to participate in the Divergent Merch Design Challenge 2026 . Your challenge is to conceptualise and design the next generation of Divergent student merchandise. We want you to go beyond conventional graphics and explore how design, typography, illustration, colours, and storytelling can come together to represent the identity and spirit of Divergent. raw.details:
Divergent Merch Design Challenge 2026:

  • Design Beyond the Ordinary. Create What Represents You.
  • What if merchandise could be more than just a logo printed on a T-shirt?
  • What if it could represent a community, a mindset, a creative journey, and a way of thinking?
  • Divergent Classes invites creative minds, design aspirants, and college students to participate in the Divergent Merch Design Challenge 2026.
  • Your challenge is to conceptualise and design the next generation of Divergent student merchandise. We want you to go beyond conventional graphics and explore how design, typography, illustration, colours, and storytelling can come together to represent the identity and spirit of Divergent.

About Divergent Classes

  • Divergent Classes is a design education organisation focused on nurturing creativity, visual thinking, and design aptitude. We believe that design is not simply about drawing or creating visually appealing graphics; it is about observing, interpreting, experimenting, and communicating ideas.

The Challenge

  • Imagine yourself as a part of Divergent's creative team. Your responsibility is to conceptualise a merchandise collection that students would genuinely love to own and wear.
  • Your designs should reflect the philosophy, identity, and community of Divergent while introducing a fresh creative direction.
  • You are encouraged to experiment with:
  • Illustrations and visual storytelling.
  • Typography and graphic compositions.
  • Symbolism and unconventional design approaches.
  • Colours, patterns, and visual identities.
  • Merchandise concepts that create a sense of belonging.

What You Need to Create

  • Concept & Ideation: Explain your central idea, inspiration, and its connection with Divergent.
  • Design Exploration: Explore at least two different creative directions. Include sketches, illustrations, references, or typography experiments.
  • Final Merchandise Design: Develop your strongest concept and apply it to at least one merchandise item, such as a T-shirt, hoodie, or tote bag.
  • Presentation: Present your creative process, design decisions, and final mockups in a structured PDF.

Who Can Participate?

  • Students, design aspirants, college students, and creative individuals interested in graphic design, illustration, branding, and visual communication.

What Are We Looking For?

  • We value original thinking, creative experimentation, conceptual clarity, brand understanding, visual communication, execution, and presentation.
  • This is not just a competition to create the most attractive merchandise. It is an opportunity to demonstrate how you think, how you interpret a brand, and how you transform an idea into a visual experience.

Don't just put a logo on a T-shirt. Give Divergent a new visual identity.

  • Let your creativity speak. Let your design be different.
  • Join the group for further updates:

Resources
WhatsApp Group

Team Divergent Classes
